outcome: Ship the Inkan M3 delivery binding
criteria: inkan check [<commit>] resolves the commit, reads its Inkan-Outcome trailers, loads each named outcome from the commit's own tree (not the working tree), refolds it, and reports outcome presence/closed-status, hash-matches-refold, and tree-matches-commit-tree, with exit 0 consistent / 1 mismatch / 2 no trailer, and never touches the working tree or suggests redoing work

inkan doctor folds every outcome file and parses every decision file, reporting corrupt outcomes, an outcome whose begin id differs from its file name, duplicate decision ids, and dangling decision links, printing ok: <n> outcomes, <m> decisions when clean, exit 0 clean / 1 problems, never repairing or deleting anything
log gains --since, --grep, --status, and --decision filters that combine with each other and with the existing -n and --lane, with help text updated to match

bench/history.js seeds ten thousand closed outcomes directly through src/store.js spread across dates and a few lanes with a few amendments, then times log({ n: 3 }), log({ grep: 'recovery' }), and doctor() against targets of 50ms/1s/2s, printing each result and exiting 1 if any target is missed, runnable as npm run bench
one test in the suite builds two thousand closed outcomes the same way and asserts, after a warm-up call, that log({ n: 3 }) is under 50ms, log({ grep }) is under 500ms, and doctor() is under 1s
DESIGN.md and README.md are updated with the check output shape and exit codes, the doctor report, the log filters, and the bench script, without touching the protocol block or other existing wording

tests cover check's consistent/no-trailer/missing-file/open-outcome/hash-mismatch/tree-mismatch cases, doctor clean and each problem kind, each log filter plus a combination, and exit codes through the binary, in at most 350 new lines under test/

note: Shipped check, doctor, log's four new filters (with a fast unfiltered -n path that avoids folding the whole history), bench/history.js plus the in-suite 2,000-outcome benchmark, and synced docs. Also fixed a pre-existing race in git.test.js's temp-index-leftover assertion, made newly likely by the added concurrent test files, by scoping it to the current process's own pid.
